description:
"abandonados pero no olvidados" en este equipo, seguiremos la historia del rover "Opportunity", somos un equipo entusiasta y que busca divertirse y obtener conocimiento, este equipo fue creado pensando en los jóvenes apasionados por el espacio y la ciencia, que no somos profesionales, pero si curiosos, este equipo es para nosotros: los "pequeños" de 12,13,14 y 15 años, "no tenemos estudios ni especialidades, pero si ganas de aprender y divertirnos" 

Atte: Mar7051, una curiosa más
summary: We created a children’s book using data provided by NASA. Our goal was to develop educational material that encourages young people and children to explore these topics—looking beyond the present and showing that there is much more to discover beyond Earth. We chose to create a book because learning to read is one of the first things a person is taught; therefore, we used simple vocabulary.
details: We created a children’s book using data provided by NASA. Our challenge was to develop educational material that would encourage young people and children to explore these topics—looking beyond the present and showing that there is much more to discover beyond Earth. We chose to create a book because learning to read is one of the first things a person is taught; therefore, we used simple vocabulary. The purpose and function of the book is to spark interest in children from an early age, as this is often when people begin to develop hobbies and personal interests.
